entry.title: Build and improve a course
entry.use_when: Plan a syllabus, connect objectives and use course feedback in your LMS.
entry.scope: Course planning, linked documents, LMS inspection and evaluation-informed revisions
entry.maturity: authored starter; live LMS behavior not tested
entry.freshness: Verify current platform, institution, course view and source versions before dependent work.
entry.limitations: An instruction set for an existing assistant; browser access and action authority depend on the host and task. No course has been published or learner outcome evaluated.

pattern.activation: an instructor is planning or revising a course, connecting course documents, inspecting an LMS or considering evaluation feedback.

use_cases.title: Turn a syllabus into a course map
use_cases.outcome: Linked objectives, activities and assessments, with genuine gaps visible.

use_cases.title: Turn a course evaluation into revisions
use_cases.outcome: Proposed changes tied to findings and a way to check the next offering.

links.why: Use the guide for LMS concepts, linked documents and checks on course changes.
Course building connects a whole course; teaching help shapes a particular explanation or lesson.
